sdf.axes: Each tile normalizes ink X/Y independently; glyph size restores natural aspect.
sdf.sampler: Point plus manual bilinear, clamp per tile; do not sample adjacent tiles

coordinates: Groups centered at origin; Y up. Atlas rectangles use PNG top-left origin; flip glyph UV Y.

provenance.formulas: ManimGL 1.7.2 Tex / native LaTeX + dvisvgm; per-use layout preserved
provenance.song: Noto Serif SC OFL-1.1 derived 400-weight subset
provenance.latin: Computer Modern Roman; native LaTeX text via ManimGL Tex/basic + dvisvgm

vector_morph.method: paired closed contours; equal-arc samples; nonzero winding
vector_morph.extraction: marching squares at SDF byte threshold 127.5; bilinear crossings; cell-mean saddle choice
vector_morph.coordinates: local glyph coordinates in [-0.5,0.5], Y up; 16-bit unsigned xy
vector_morph.packing: two RGBA pixels per vertex (source/target); all-255 contour break
vector_morph.component_matching: outer components first; holes only within matched parent; winding and cyclic phase aligned
vector_morph.birth_death: zero-area contours grow from or contract to nearest boundary anchors; no opacity ramp
vector_morph.endpoints: original SDF; 2.5% endpoint interval reconciles polygon sampling and SDF AA
vector_morph.limitations: bounded polygon approximation, not native Manim curve topology or pixel-equivalent Transform
